name: startuphafen-devcontainer
services:
  caddy:
    command:
      - caddy
      - run
      - --config
      - /etc/caddy/Caddyfile.local
      - --adapter
      - caddyfile
    container_name: startuphafen-caddy
    environment:
      BACKEND_HOST: devcontainer:5000
      FRONTEND_HOST: devcontainer:4201
      TZ: Europe/Berlin
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD-SHELL
        - wget -qO- http://127.0.0.1:2020/health || exit 1
      timeout: 2s
      interval: 30s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 30s
      start_interval: 1s
    image: caddy:2.11-alpine
    init: true
    networks:
      default: null
    ports:
      - mode: ingress
        target: 8080
        published: "4000"
        protocol: tcp
    restart: unless-stopped
    volumes:
      - type: bind
        source: /workspace/apps/startuphafen-backend/src/assets/caddy
        target: /etc/caddy
        read_only: true
        bind: {}
  database:
    command:
      - postgres
      - -c
      - timezone=Europe/Berlin
      - -c
      - log_timezone=Europe/Berlin
    container_name: startuphafen-database
    environment:
      POSTGRES_DB: app
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: app
      POSTGRES_USER: app
      TZ: Europe/Berlin
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD-SHELL
        - pg_isready -U app
      timeout: 5s
      interval: 5s
      retries: 5
    image: pgvector/pgvector:pg15
    init: true
    networks:
      default: null
    restart: unless-stopped
    volumes:
      - type: bind
        source: /workspace
        target: /workspace
        bind: {}
  devcontainer:
    build:
      context: /workspace/.devcontainer
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
    command:
      - sleep
      - infinity
    container_name: startuphafen-devcontainer
    networks:
      default: null
